title: The Faithful Compass
author: Ada Ravensworth
blurb: Sebastian Montrose, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the census taker asks one question too many, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the century turns.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
